notes.title: 4K Update!
notes.notes:
Hey, capybara seekers!

In this update, we've doubled the resolution of all hidden capybaras, cats, lights, as well as the background and menu elements.

What's more, many capybaras have been redrawn and enriched with new details (their faces are now more visible!). Additionally, the lights now feature new colors and styles. We hope you’ll enjoy the refreshed look of the capybaras!

But that's not all! The game now includes features introduced in later Hidden Capybaras with Orange games, such as keyboard camera controls, time display after completing a level, improved controls on Steam Deck, and cloud saves.

As always, we look forward to your feedback!

[b]Full changelog:[/b]
- Increased the resolution and quality of all capybaras, cats, background, and lights.
- Doubled the resolution of user interface elements.
- Improved the quality of visual effects when clicking on a capybara and upon finding all capybaras.
- Added a timer displaying the time after completing a level.
- Added camera control using WSAD on the keyboard.
- Improved controls on Steam Deck.
- Added support for Steam Cloud Save.
- Various minor fixes.


And finally, a small announcement:
We designed Hidden Capybaras with Orange to have no in-game text, making it accessible to all players regardless of the languages they speak. However, there are still elements like game descriptions and achievement texts that need translation.

While we do our best to translate them, we can't cover every language. So, if you'd like to help us translate the game descriptions and achievements into your language or any other language you know, feel free to reach out – your support would be greatly appreciated!

notes.title: 4K Update - Announcement!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Capybara Seekers!

We’re excited to announce a major visual update for Hidden Capybaras with Orange!

After releasing Hidden Capybaras with Orange: Spooky Halloween Edition and Hidden Capybaras with Orange in the Whimsical Library, we realized that the first part of Hidden Capybaras could look even better than it does now!

In the upcoming update, we plan to double the resolution of all capybaras, backgrounds, and GUI elements, as well as enhance the lighting effects on nighttime levels for a deeper and more immersive experience.

Take a sneak peek at how the update will look! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779498/9e708a9de7b8a876a9fe6ba9f8a54cf6251d1c4f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779498/00fa65bc3e27d53e9234a496912b85410004c3a3.png[/img]

Stay tuned and keep an eye out for the update coming next week!

notes.title: Update 1.1 available!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Greetings, capybara seekers![/h3][/b]
We're happy to bring you the first update of Hidden Capybaras with Orange!

What's new:
[list]
[*][b]Added controller support![/b]

Don't like using a mouse? No problem! We've added controls for game controllers. Use the left stick to control the cursor, the right stick to move the camera, the triggers to control zoom in and out, 'A' to confirm and 'B' to back.

[*][b]Night levels improvements[/b]

We realised that the glow of some of the capybaras could overshadow everything else and make searching more challenging. We have improved this aspect by making the night levels clearer, but we didn’t take away their charm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779498/0ff1005404ce5ef7448032b2e88ab6a413d29ace.gif[/img]

[*][b]New icons[/b]

We have added new icons for sound and music settings as well as for the gamepad if it is connected.
[/list]
[h3]We are Whimsical Universes![/h3]

We've changed our team name. From now on, we're Whimsical Universes! Unfortunately, if you've been following our developer page, you'll need to re-follow us.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/whimsicaluniverses][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779498/2b753b727aa11cc4da1e95e65ce2098f179b4271.png[/img][/url]

Oh, and the team logo should now directly open the developer page in an overlay. Just in case you want to follow us and receive notifications when the second part is released...
